01 — About

A Decade of Packaging Depth, Digitally Amplified.

A print & packaging leader who digitises the QC, prepress and reporting workflows around him.

I'm Nakka Narendra, a Printing & Packaging professional with over 10 years of hands-on experience across packaging development, prepress & artwork QA, colour management, secure packaging and anti-counterfeit technology.

My career started on the press floor — gravure, flexo, offset and digital at their deepest technical level. Today I'm Lead – Printing at Ennoventure Technologies, owning artwork feasibility, prepress validation, colour compliance and print/authentication quality for leading global pharma, FMCG and automotive brands.

What sets me apart: I identified operational gaps in daily printing and packaging work and built 10+ internal tools to close them — driving digital transformation across QC, prepress and reporting, from a decade of knowing exactly what the industry needs.

Deep packaging domain knowledge + hands-on digital transformation — a combination that barely exists in the industry. That's the gap I live in.
